_ssot.role: Pivot targets FROM KP-NAI-014 (Villa Nai-Wok) — faithful transcription of the existing 'BUDGET ROUTING' block in sections/20-catalog-villa-nai-wok.tmpl (KPR-302 pivot-layer build, step 3). Content/meaning unchanged; structured for the future §34 router. §20 keeps its own copy until Step 5 strips it. Unlike §17/18/22, §20's router is multi-directional (three distinct pivot targets by budget tier), not a simple up/down pair.

pivot_targets.line_he: יש לי פרויקט חוף בלעדי יותר — רוצה לשמוע?
pivot_targets.line_en: I have a more exclusive beachfront project — want to hear about it?

pivot_targets.line_he: יש לי אפשרות מעניינת בתקציב שלך — רוצה שאשלח?
pivot_targets.line_en: I have an interesting option in your budget range — want me to send it?

pivot_targets.note: Alternative: present NAI-014's own hidden option ({{KP-NAI-014.jungle.thb_m}}) first if close to the lead's stated range, before pivoting away.
pivot_targets.line_he: יש לי גם פרויקט בסריטאנו בטווח הזה — {{KP-SRI-013.range.thb_m}}.
pivot_targets.line_en: I also have a project in Srithanu in that range — {{KP-SRI-013.range.thb_m}}.

pivot_targets.note: Out of range for villa projects — no pivot target, politely decline and offer to follow up if new inventory appears.
pivot_targets.line_he: בתקציב הזה אין לי כרגע וילה מתאימה, אבל אם משהו חדש ייכנס — אעדכן אותך
pivot_targets.line_en: At that budget I don't have a matching villa right now, but if something new comes in — I'll let you know

hidden_option_note: KP-NAI-014 also has its own in-catalog 'hidden option' (jungle villa, {{KP-NAI-014.jungle.thb_m}}) deployed on a price objection BEFORE pivoting to another project — this is an own-inventory upsell/downsell, not a cross-project pivot, so it is not modeled as a pivot_target here (it already lives in §20's OBJECTION HANDLING, unchanged).
